title: blessed/release-candidate/v1
description: Immutable producer candidate manifest (releases.candidate@1). Says WHAT was built as a CLOSED, fully-hashed file set. Channel-neutral: canary/stable belong to promotion, not candidate truth. Contains no surface-specific public URLs. The manifest itself is signed with ed25519-detached-v1 for every promoted candidate; per-artifact signatures are additionally required for unattended executable install and may declare a runtime-native profile.

safeBasename.description: Basename only — no path separators, no traversal, no leading dot.

version.description: Anchored MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH[-PRERELEASE]. Build metadata (+build) is NOT supported in candidate versions, so `tag == "v" + version` always holds.

signing.description: Candidate-envelope signing metadata that is COVERED BY the manifest signature (it lives inside the signed bytes). This is the producer->verifier path for the manifest key: the verifier reads key_id ONLY to select a public key from its baked/pinned trust store, then verifies the exact manifest bytes with that key BEFORE trusting key_id or anything else here. profile/key_id describe the candidate envelope and are the inherited defaults for artifact signatures; artifacts records whether per-artifact signatures are required. The manifest signature itself is the envelope and is not in `files`.

key_id.description: Names a public key in the verifier's baked trust store (e.g. kioskitd-2026-01). Untrusted until the manifest signature verifies.

artifacts.description: 'required' for unattended executable install (per-artifact .sig mandatory); 'optional' otherwise.
Installable outputs. Selection is (platform, install_kind) or id — one platform may have several outputs (binary/tarball/rpm/deb), so platform alone is ambiguous.

platform.description: 'any' or os/arch, e.g. linux/amd64, darwin/arm64, windows/amd64.

signature_profile.description: Optional per-artifact signature profile. v1 recognizes the Tauri native updater adapter only. If absent, inherits top-level signing.profile. If present, signature and signature_key_id must also be present (enforced by semantic validation).

signature_key_id.description: Optional per-artifact key id. If absent, inherits top-level signing.key_id. If present, signature and signature_profile must also be present (enforced by semantic validation).

files.description: CLOSED set of the candidate PAYLOAD files, each hashed: installers, SHA256SUMS, per-artifact .sig, SBOMs, release-notes-public.md, provenance. The manifest (release-candidate.json) and its detached signature (release-candidate.json.sig) are the ENVELOPE and are NOT listed here (self-reference would be circular). The published candidate = these two envelope files + exactly the files listed here; the surface rejects anything else.
